name: sap-insight-copilot
description: SAP Insight Copilot monorepo with CAP backend and Next.js frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n CAP,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w cap" "npm run dev -w app"
scripts.build: npm run build -w cap && npm run build -w app
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n CAP,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w cap" "npm run start -w app"
scripts.test: npm run test:router && node --test cap/tests/mm.test.js cap/tests/fi.test.js cap/tests/router.test.js
